title: feat: prefix community model IDs and migrate key permissions
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Promotes `community/owner/model` to the canonical ID for community models and agents. The old `owner/model` ID stays a generation alias on every listing, including newly created ones.
- Migration `0065` renames stored key permissions in D1. Key writes validate canonical-ID membership only; no alias lookup or permission fallback.
- Preserves monitoring history, probe cadence, catalog collision checks and canonical billing attribution. Reward attribution keys off the owner's user ID, not the model string.
- Every ID is built through `communityModelId` / `legacyCommunityModelId`, so the rename is contained to six callers.

Verified on staging (enter + gen deployed, `0065` applied):
- Catalog flipped to `community/...` for all 8 community listings, each carrying the bare alias.
- Generation returns 200 for both ID forms; `x-model-requested` and `x-model-used` both report canonical.
- Full 8-model status matrix identical before and after; bundled models unaffected.

Follow-ups, not blockers: the `community/` stripping in the monitor SQL is only needed while the 24h/7d windows span the rename; `probe.mjs` keeps legacy state-file keys; the two leaderboards display the stripped ID while seven-day-health displays canonical.
